name: Normal-Only Region Conformalization
scientific_question: Past module failures share a root cause: auxiliary evidence exists but there is no principled answer to 'when is it trustworthy?'. Instead of another black-box gate, can a normal-only region-level non-conformity distribution assign each candidate region an auditable p-value / confidence level, and gate any auxiliary module modification of A1 by p<=0.05 with identity fallback otherwise? NORC's value is risk control (normal-image FPR, cross-domain safety, explainable fallback), NOT raw AP.

phase_r0_scope.calibration_unit_and_effective_sample_si: calibration unit = normal reference IMAGE (leave-one-reference-out) plus a pre-registered finite set of deterministic mild augmentations (hflip, brightness x0.9/1.1, rot -2/+2 deg for small-angle classes where stable); patches within one image are NOT independent -> effective sample size = number of calibration IMAGES x per-image non-conformity, never raw patch count
phase_r0_scope.exchangeability_note: test image distribution is assumed shift-free vs normal reference images in-domain (MPDD dev). Strict coverage guarantees are NOT claimed across datasets; nominal coverage deviation across seeds is measured instead
phase_r0_scope.non_conformity_per_region: region-level score of a candidate region (A1 or auxiliary) = region max, mean, P90 + multi-view stability when available; stratified by area bin and coarse position bin
phase_r0_scope.conformal_rank: p = (1 + #{calibration scores >= test score}) / (n_calib + 1); modification of A1 allowed only if p <= 0.05, else exact identity
phase_r0_scope.identity_fallback: when no auxiliary module is active, output == A1 exactly (max|diff| 0)

minimal_implementation: NORC module + identity pass-through + normal-image FPR accounting hooks; gates evaluated once an auxiliary module (CRAM candidate or STR) is integrated

gates.g0_identity: identity fallback test passes (output == A1 when no region passes p<=0.05)
gates.g2_fpr: normal-image image-FPR or normal-pixel high-score rate drops >= 20% vs uncalibrated auxiliary module
gates.g3_coverage: across-seed nominal coverage deviation <= 5 percentage points
gates.note: gate for combination with A/B/C: worst-category regression improves >= 50% while keeping >= 50% of mean gain

leakage: all calibration from normal reference images + pre-registered augmentations; no test GT
